I5/I6/I11: search.py:2056-2091 widens the fetch through _NEIGHBOUR_FETCH_FACTORS (1, 4, 16), capped at _NEIGHBOUR_FETCH_MAX=4096 (search.py:1583-1586). The stop check counts only rows that pass _visible_neighbours (type, not the source, active, drive; search.py:1940-1952), and the quality filters see only those neighbours. I6 cap: I traced test_spec_addon_023_the_cap_ends_the_widening_and_what_was_found_is_returned (test_vec_partition_similar.py:125-141) by hand. The source, 4087 other-drive rows and c0-c2 fill 4091 of the 4096 slots, so the files inside the cap come back and the 'far' files beyond it do not. This matches the invariant's bound.

I1/I2: vec_partition.py:124-190 rebuilds every pending table inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT on an autocommit raw connection. The staging copy is an inner JOIN with embeddings, so orphans are dropped and the vector bytes are copied, not recomputed. On any BaseException it runs ROLLBACK and then a checkpoint. Tables that are already partitioned are skipped before anything is written, and the free-space refusal raises before BEGIN.

I8: start and done INFO lines (vec_partition.py:141-166) carry, per table, copied=, orphans_dropped= and the elapsed time. wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) runs after both commit and rollback. The repair logs one line only when it rekeyed or dropped a row (vec_partition.py:244-247).

I9: repair_unkeyed_rows re-keys each NULL row with delete+insert in a per-batch transaction and keeps the original bytes (vec_partition.py:64-81, 208-248). A raised batch rolls back, so its NULL rows stay for the next start.
potential_unspecified_behavior: When the free-space check refuses, _migrate has already run a wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) (vec_partition.py:129) before it raises. That is a checkpoint, not a row write, so it does not break I2's 'nothing is written'. It does touch the -wal file.
regression_risks: The widening re-runs the KNN up to three times per similar-files call when the drive or active filter discards many neighbours. Latency on a large production partition was not measured here; the decisions.md pending list notes this too.
